checks.name: Every supported media document survives exact draft encoding and normalizer validation
Invalid raw numbers, blank fields, and discarded tracks are diagnosed without modifying the draft
Invalid timeline rates and skin indices are rejected before any normalization can silently repair them
Recovery rejects an unrelated envelope instead of treating it as a typed draft
Actual Inspector recording updates only the visible draft and recovery, leaving persisted AssetDatabase source unchanged
Record mode survives the editor unmount boundary and retains later scene edits in the same draft
A concurrently saved source produces a visible retained-base conflict instead of an overwrite
Track-capacity refusal is atomic and exposes its actual limit
Full key tracks allow exact snapped replacements and refuse any additional frame atomically
Nonfinite recorded properties and a replaced live asset object cannot partially change a draft
Explicit project discard releases the active recording draft and record mode
Runtime recording snapshot is detached and neither writes an asset nor clears captured samples
An editor audition uses real AudioRuntime routing and absolute seek without mutating the authored scene
Disposing an editor audition leaves independent game audio playing and releases its own media element
Recording reset observers receive detached final evaluated samples and unsubscribe without changing capture

scope: Actual bundled production normalizers, AssetDatabase, recording, draft retention and animation evaluator. No browser geometry or complete user workflow claim.
tracingScope: Positive V8 function entries during the complete passing programmer suite, including fixture setup. Not per-assertion isolation, exhaustive domain coverage or performance qualification.
